_comment: Data-driven extraction map for budget-vs-actual. Describes WHERE each budget metric lives in the borrower's approved budget workbook, so the engine stays borrower-agnostic. Produced by monitor-setup; budget-vs-actual reads it from paths.budget_map_path. Row and column indices are 1-based (openpyxl). Copy to budget-map.json and fill in with the real rows/columns for the pinned budget.
file: <approved budget workbook .xlsx — same as borrower-config paths.budget_path>
file_mount: <OPTIONAL: an already-resolved path to the same workbook; if set, used instead of 'file'>
sheet: <the budget P&L sheet/tab name that IS the approved budget>

period_columns._comment: ISO month-end -> 1-based column index of that month's budget figures. List every month the budget covers that the monitor may report on.

metric_rows._comment: Canonical metric -> budget row(s). A value is an int (single row), a list of ints (summed), or {"add":[...],"subtract":[...]}. revenue is required. For EBITDA map exactly ONE of: 'ebitda', the plan's own EBITDA row, when the plan stops at EBITDA; OR the rows that build it, net_income, interest_expense, taxes, depreciation_amortization (plus financing_cost / interest_income only if the plan has them). A map naming both is refused. gross_profit is optional: leave out any line the plan does not have, and never fill a line from another row or a blank row, because the engine reads a missing line as no plan and a borrowed or blank row as a plan figure. Replace the example row numbers with the real ones.

balance_sheet_rows._comment: OPTIONAL. Budget BALANCE-SHEET rows for the memo's Collateral 'vs Budget' column. Keys MUST match collateral-map.json pledged_components labels exactly; values are budget-workbook row(s) on the SAME sheet/period_columns as above (same value shapes as metric_rows: int, list to sum, or {add,subtract}). Include ONLY components the budget actually plans (a missing key renders '—' for that component). Omit this whole block when the pinned budget carries no balance-sheet section — the memo then input-gates the column with one appendix-F note.

opex_groups._comment: Display name -> budget row(s), same value shapes as metric_rows. Keys MUST match borrower-config.opex_groups keys so actual and budget opex are compared like-for-like. The {add,subtract} shape lets you reconcile a different chart of accounts (e.g. carve fulfillment-type costs out of a budget G&A row).
